Company Release - 11/24/2026 CACI to Participate in the UBS Global Industrials & Transportation Conference


RESTON, Va.


, Nov. 24, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- CACI International Inc ([NYSE: CACI](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4830603-1&h=3441347083&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nyse.com%2Fquote%2FXNYS%3ACACI&a=NYSE%3A+CACI) ) announced today that it will participate in the UBS Global Industrials & Transportation Conference.


[President and Chief Executive Officer John Mengucci](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4830603-1&h=3417704860&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caci.com%2Fbio%2Fjohn-s-mengucci&a=President+and+Chief+Executive+Officer+John+Mengucci) and[Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer Jeff MacLauchlan](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4830603-1&h=2334953615&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caci.com%2Fbio%2Fjeffrey-d-maclauchlan&a=Chief+Financial+Officer+and+Treasurer+Jeff+MacLauchlan) will engage in a fireside chat and question-and-answer session on Tuesday, December 1, at 9:40 a.m. Eastern time.


A live audio webcast of the event will be available on the[CACI investor relations website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4830603-1&h=392444890&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.caci.com%2Fevents%2Fdefault.aspx&a=CACI+investor+relations+website) , and a replay will be posted for 90 days following the event.


**About CACI** CACI International Inc (NYSE: CACI) is a technology-first national security company that expands the limits of national security through innovation, discipline, and operational excellence. We deliver advanced technologies that help our customers move faster, operate more efficiently, and anticipate and defeat evolving threats. Our 27,000 talented employees and strong culture drive our success and have earned CACI recognition as a Fortune World's Most Admired Company. CACI is a member of the Fortune 500™, the Russell 1000 Index, and the S&P MidCap 400 Index. For more information, visit caci.com.
